claim: Every connected simple graph with more than one vertex whose average degree is at most its number of pendant vertices is well totally dominated.

definitions.total_dominating_set: A vertex set S such that every vertex has a neighbor in S.
definitions.minimal_total_dominating_set: A total dominating set with no proper subset that is a total dominating set.
definitions.well_totally_dominated: All minimal total dominating sets have the same cardinality.
